content.text:
A Filament panel is configured in a Laravel PanelProvider: return a Panel from panel(), assign a unique panel ID with ->id('admin'), then customize path, auth, resources, pages, widgets, middleware, theme, navigation, and plugins. The provider is a normal Laravel service provider and must be registered. Official docs: .

## Plugins and IDs

A panel plugin implements Filament\Contracts\Plugin:
```
public function getId(): string { return 'acme-reports'; } public function register(Panel $panel): void { /* $panel->resources(...), etc. */ } public function boot(Panel $panel): void { /* runtime boot */ }
```
Add it per panel with ->plugins([ReportsPlugin::make()]). register() mutates panel configuration; boot() runs only when that panel is actually used. This supports distinct configuration or plugin instances per panel.

## Duplicate behavior

Panel IDs are registry keys: registering a second panel with the same ID throws Exception("A panel has already been registered with the ID [...]"); it is not silently overridden. Canonical source: .
Plugin IDs are associative-array keys within a panel: HasPlugins::plugin() assigns $this->plugins[$plugin->getId()] = $plugin. Therefore, a duplicate plugin ID replaces the earlier plugin instance silently for that panel; only the final one is registered/booted. Use vendor-prefixed, stable IDs. Canonical source: packages/panels/src/Panel/Concerns/HasPlugins.php.

Sources:
1. [Panel configuration](https://filamentphp.com/docs/3.x/panels/configuration)
2. [filamentphp](https://filamentphp.com/docs/3.x/panels/plugins)
